programme.desc: Western Australian countrymen look back on the time when they were awarded citizenship and how it has affected their lives since

programme.title: Kamara: (Black Soil) Bush Yams
programme.desc: Violet Wadrill Nanaku, Topsy Dodd Ngarnjal Nangari and Biddy Wavehill Yamawurr Nangala head east of Kalakaringi to the black soil plains searchng for yams

programme.title: Balangara Films: Looking After Our Past, Present and Future
programme.desc: The Pilliga's natural wilderness and the indigenous cultures intrinsically tied to it is under immanent threat from gas and coal seam mining

programme.title: 27 ADR Presentation 11 - Special Rapporteur wrap up
programme.desc: The Australian Dispute Centre presents the Oceans Nine Conference, powering the surge in global dispute resolution.

programme.title: NEWS 78 - Numbulwar IPA Sea Rights NEWS
Wanem You See The Future For Torres Strait?
programme.desc: Community members of the Torres Strait discuss plans to ensure that they remain strong and healthy whatever the future brings

programme.title: Desert kitchen: Warakurna
programme.desc: Desert Kitchen with Nara Wilson in Warakurna Community

programme.title: Barrangal Dyara
programme.desc: The Garden Palace on Gadigal land was the vision of Henry Parkes built in 1879 and housed significant cultural materials from the south-east Murray-Darling and coastal regions until the 22nd of September 1882 when the Palace burnt down

programme.title: Karu Kamparnup "Termite Mound Treatment"
programme.desc: Gurindji women Connie Ngarmeiye Ngala, Lisa Smiler Langari and Sarah Oscar Nananku talk about how and why they use termite mound treatment for babies and new mothers

programme.title: Kurraj "Rainbow Serpent Story"
programme.desc: Gurindji woman Violet Wadrill Nanaku tells the story of countrymen who tried to cook a baby Rainbow Serpent

programme.title: Rodeo Road
programme.desc: Follow a cast of rodeo diehards as they compete for glory and 8 seconds of fame at outback Rodeos that are the real deal. Robbie Newman is a Cherokee horse whisperer and roping champ, Wayne Swan is a Kimberley legend bull rider and the Dolbys are just Rodeo mad. The action is all set around the cowboys and jillaroos who work hard on cattle stations throughout the Kimberley in North West Australia.

programme.title: Kawurn "Ashes for Tobacco"
programme.desc: Gurindji women Violet, Topsy, Biddy and Peggy take us through the process of using ghost gum ashes to make a chewing tobacco additive

programme.title: Lorraine
programme.desc: Lorraine Jones is chairperson of Wirib Store in Timber Creek and talks a bit about the site, associated clan groups and their "Dingo Dreaming"

programme.title: Kilipi "Bush Bananas"
programme.desc: Gurindji women Bidi Wavehill Nangala and Violet Wadril Nanaku show us how to collect and prepare kilipi or bush bananas

programme.title: AIG Remote Laundries
programme.desc: Aboriginal Investment Group talks to locals about the "Remote Laundry Project" and it's effect on the Barunga and Beswick communities

programme.title: PJ Masks

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: Ranger Marsh retells the story of how Shellington was able to help, Ronny, a monitor lizard, find his brothers.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends
programme.desc: When Thomas accidentally breaks a light he's hauling to the Sodor Festival of Lights, he learns the best way to be the Number 1 engine is to be honest when you make a mistake.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Three paints Two with one too many blocks and realises disguises won't help.

programme.title: Mittens & Pants
programme.desc: When Mittens' cousin, Ropa, comes to visit, she over-plans the whole day, which threatens to ruin all the spontaneous fun.

programme.title: Fantus And The Animals
programme.desc: Fantus meets a goat. It balances on a log and climbs up to eat from a tree.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: George is sad when Suzy Sheep comes to play and Peppa won't let him join in their games. Later, when Peppa and Suzy want to play doctors and nurses, George is happy to be the patient.

programme.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
programme.sub-title: The Wiggly Days Of The Week
programme.desc: Join Evie and Dorothy for some graceful 'Row, Row, Row Your Boat Ballet.' Then embark on a week-long journey to explore the days of the week, discover the surprises each day brings, making it full of exciting adventures!

programme.title: Shaun the Sheep

programme.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
programme.desc: With help from Bootsie, Team Spidey foils Sandman's theft of priceless Egyptian artifacts.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Evil Pea tricks Supertato and the Veggies, who fall into the deli counter and come face to face with the Turnip of Terror. They escape with help from the not-so-scary Turnip.

programme.title: Superkitties
programme.desc: When the pets' Howloween treats go missing all over Kittydale, the SuperKitties must track down the thief, even if it turns out to be the spooky Howloween Cat that Bitsy fears.

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
programme.desc: The Wise Old Elf teaches the elf children how to tell the time using a watch, while Nanny Plum would much rather use a dandelion clock to teach the fairy children.

programme.title: Flower & Flour
programme.desc: When a wheel-less golf buggy is dumped in the plaza, the neighbourhood kids band together to turn junk into art.

programme.title: Flower & Flour
programme.desc: Flower decides cats shouldn't say 'meow' anymore, and soon Flour is speaking only in 'beep beep.' When Cockatoo takes a liking to Flour's new language, Flower feels left out as the two new friends romp around the plaza.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Peppa and her friends are at Playgroup with Madame Gazelle. The children will be learning about the weather by building a weather station.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
